{{Top|leg}}
A '''Grand Proclamation''' was a type of statement made by the [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Squib Polyanarchy]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], King [[Ebareebaveebeedee]] made at least three Grand Proclamations in response to the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], one declaring the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to be "[[koovy]]," and one affirming [[Skor II]]'s commitment to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
